name: SUT
fix_description: In buyTokens(), fix the integer division truncation: (_numberOfTokens/1e18)*tokenPrice truncates to 0 when _numberOfTokens < 1e18. Change to (_numberOfTokens * tokenPrice) / 1e18 to maintain precision, or require _numberOfTokens >= 1e18.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, straightforward exploit: take a flash loan, exploit an incorrectly priced token sale purchase, then swap the bought tokens back to WBNB and repay. The vulnerability pattern is obvious from the PoC and only involves a few external calls with minimal protocol-specific complexity.
